reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The `ValidateCAA` feature gate has been deprecated and will be removed in cert-manager v1.18", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: Enabling the ValidateCAA feature gate still works in 1.17 but prints a warning; the gate will be removed in cert-manager 1.18.
consequence.remediation: Stop manually enabling the ValidateCAA feature gate.

proposed.statement: The ValidateCAA feature gate is deprecated in cert-manager 1.17 (enabling it prints a warning) and will be removed in 1.18.
